t: What are Active and Passive Elements? - Definition with Explanation
s: May 17, 2020 - Active and Passive elements are two different types of circuit element. This classification is based on the capability of circuit element to deliver energy either in the form of voltage or current. If a circuit element has the capability to deliver energy to the circuit, it is called Active element whereas if the element consumes energy then it is called passive element.
